title: Geometric reducedness in characteristic p versus reducedness of the Frobenius twist
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: The proof identifies the absolute Frobenius F_k : k -> k with the inclusion k  inside  k^{1/p} (its image is k^p, and Frobenius on a field is an isomorphism onto its image), which converts the statement into the delivered-style k^{1/p} criterion of lemma-geometrically-reduced. H2: the identification F_k = inclusion into k^{1/p} is the single substantive step, applied to a named criterion.
